purpose: CMS field contract for wholesale FAQ rendering
rule: Do not render a factual FAQ answer when its required fields are empty or unverified. MOQ is a SKU/model field, never a category field.

fallbacks.moq: MOQ is confirmed for the selected SKU, decoration method, packaging configuration, and destination. Some made-to-order models are not available by carton or small batch. Send your quantity and requirements for a product-specific quotation.
fallbacks.lead_time: FOB dispatch timing is confirmed against the selected SKU, approved artwork, packaging configuration, quantity, and agreed order route. Destination-specific freight arrival is quoted separately.
fallbacks.sample: Sample availability and cost are confirmed for the selected SKU and customization route. Include the SKU, artwork, packaging requirement, and destination when requesting a sample.

moqDisplayModes.quote_only: Do not show a number. Use the MOQ fallback answer.
moqDisplayModes.published_verified: Show only the approved MOQ for the exact SKU/model and order route.
moqDisplayModes.sample_private: Internal sales-only setting. Do not expose as public MOQ or public availability.

leadTimeRules.public_text: In-stock samples are dispatched within 1–3 working days after payment is received.
For no-stock small batches, including samples, FOB dispatch normally takes 10–15 days.
For no-stock orders of 1,000 pcs or more, FOB dispatch normally takes 15–25 days.
For no-stock electric wine openers, milk frothers, pepper grinders, coffee machines, and related electrical products, FOB dispatch normally takes 45–60 working days.

schemaRules.product: Render only factual public product data.
schemaRules.faqPage: Optional. Visible FAQ text must exactly match markup. Do not expect a Google FAQ rich result.
